other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam
Applicant must be a nominee or dependent of the deceased worker
Deceased worker must have been engaged in any building and other construction work
Deceased worker must have been registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Deceased worker must have had an active membership with the Board
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 for death due to natural causes and ₹3,00,000 for death due to accident during employment.
